messages:
ellen: FYI exec approved Quiet Window policy v1.0. Were rolling it org-wide next Wed 00:00-06:00 UTC. Purpose: reduce noisy maintenance-triggered SLO burn and give oncall explicit rules for suppressed alerts. Key bits: alert suppression windows, burn-rate crediting for scheduled maintenance, and a short calibration test. TL;DR: new policy + calibration run + update runbooks.

raj: Could you paste the high-level rules? Want to confirm edge cases (partial-region maintenance, cross-tenant impact).

ellen: High-level: 1) Quiet Window declared for a scope (region/pool/service) suppresses non-critical p99 and p50 alerts for that scope only. 2) Burn-rate credits: scheduled maintenance will be subtracted from monthly burn calculus if ticketed & run under Quiet Window. 3) Emergency alerts (errors >1% OR infrastructure OOMs) still fire. 4) Quiet Window must be declared at least 24h ahead and linked to RFC. 5) Calibration run required before first use per region. Full doc: https://intranet.redwood/sre/policies/quiet-window-v1

marta: Calibration plan proposal: run a 30m synthetic that simulates maintenance traffic patterns while Quiet Window is active; verify suppressed alerts stay suppressed, emergency thresholds still fire, and burn-rate calc records maintenance credit. Propose Fri 02:00-03:00 UTC calibration for us-west.

ci-bot: Policy change: quiet-window-v1.0 proposed by ellen awaiting signatures from eng-sre leads.

ops-lead: I like Fri calibration. Will coordinate with infra to ensure we tag the maintenance ticket correctly (use label: quiet-window-calibration/us-west). Also will own the ticket.

raj: Observability checklist: - ensure alert-suppression rules tied to scope label - create dryrun.metrics:quietwindow.* - synthetic probes in us-west/us-east/eu - burn-rate accounting test: simulate scheduled maintenance metadata in RTC. I'll add to runbook.

ellen: Calibration command for loadtest cluster (teams who want to join):
```
./tools/loadtest --duration 30m --qps 500 --header "x-test-scope: us-west" --tag quiet-window-calib-2024
```
We'll run at 02:10 and 02:40.

marta: Runbook updates I'll add: declaration checklist, ticket naming, escalation exceptions, and post-calibration verification steps. Link soon.

slo-bot: SLO note: Quiet Window will not count scheduled maintenance into monthly burn if ticket label present. Draft diff: https://intranet.redwood/slo/diffs/quiet-window-credit. Effective after calibration.

ops-lead: Support heads will get canned messaging for customers if maintenance is visible. We'll put a short blurb in #support-templates.

ellen: Owners: @ops-lead ticketing + exec notifications, @marta runbook + calibration lead, @raj observability + metric changes. I'll own policy signoff and post-calibration summary. Keep updates short in this thread during calibration. React to ack. :white_check_mark:

raj: ack :thumbsup:

marta: ack :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Reminder 48h: quiet-window-v1.0 calibration scheduled in 48 hours.
